blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — The Regional Development Council in Ilocos Region (Region I) has approved 30 priority projects that has an estimated P5.497 billion in investment requirement for fiscal year 2028. La Union Gov. Mario Eduardo C. Ortega, RDC chairperson, said the council endorsed projects aimed at strengthening key development sectors covering health, transport and connectivity, agriculture and irrigation, education, social protection, science and technology, innovation, and water security for possible inclusion in the updated Public Investment Program and the 2028 national budget.
